Brand.tagline: Verified PG beds in Delhi NCR

Metadata.description: Find a verified PG bed near your college in Delhi NCR. Book a visit, reserve with a refundable token and move in.

Home.intro: Find a safe, verified bed near your college or coaching hub. Book a visit, reserve the bed with a small refundable token and move in.

find.title: Find
find.body: Browse verified PGs on a map, near your college or coaching hub.

visit.title: Visit
visit.body: Book a visit and see the room before you decide.

reserve.title: Reserve
reserve.body: Hold your bed with a small token that counts toward your first month's rent.

moveIn.title: Move in
moveIn.body: Your token stays protected until you have moved in and checked the room.

students.title: For students and parents
students.body: Students pay no platform fee. Someone from our team visits every building, checks its safety and takes the photos before it is listed.

owners.title: For PG owners
owners.body: Fill your beds with verified tenants. You pay a one-time placement fee for each tenant we place.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: This page doesn't exist or has moved.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: This page couldn't load. Please try again.

SignIn.title: Sign in or create an account

phone.title: Your mobile number
phone.intro: We'll send a six-digit code to it by SMS.
phone.label: Mobile number
phone.hint: An Indian mobile number, such as 98765 43210.
phone.humanCheck: First, a quick check that you're not a bot.

code.title: Enter the code
code.intro: We sent a six-digit code to {phone}. It works for 5 minutes.
code.label: Six-digit code
code.resendLater: Didn't get it? You can ask for a new one shortly.

consent.title: Before we create your account
consent.intro: We need your agreement to keep an account for you. The privacy notice says what we keep, why, and for how long.
consent.notice: Read the privacy notice (opens in a new tab)
consent.account: I agree to {brand} keeping my account and the details I give, to arrange visits, bookings and payments for me, as the privacy notice describes.
consent.accountRequired: You need to agree to this to create an account.
consent.marketing: Send me offers and news by SMS, WhatsApp or email. This is optional, and you can stop them at any time.

profile.title: About you
profile.intro: So we know what to call you, and which PGs suit you.

authenticator.title: Your authenticator code
authenticator.intro: Enter the six-digit code your authenticator app shows for {brand} staff.
authenticator.label: Authenticator code

Profile.name: Your name
Profile.nameHint: What you'd like us to call you.
Profile.placeHint: Helps us show you PGs near it.
Profile.genderHint: Used only to show the PGs you can stay in: girls', boys' or co-living.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.draft: Draft: this notice is still being written, and a lawyer will review it before launch.
Privacy.purposes: What you agree to when you create an account
Privacy.account: Your account (needed): your mobile number and the details you give, to sign you in and to arrange visits, bookings and payments for you.
Privacy.marketing: Offers and news (optional): messages about PGs and offers, by SMS, WhatsApp or email, only if you choose them.
Privacy.rights: You can download a copy of your data, withdraw optional consent, or ask for your account's deletion from your account page.
